TEXT: It has been a few days after I met Saori in Akihabara.
Since then, I have not been in contact with her.
She won't pick up her cell phone or log into the chat.
She hasn't been on any social network sites, and hasn't contacted Kirino or anyone else.
With nothing to do, I spent my days staring at my silent cellphone.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: What's wrong, having a staring contest with your phone?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Not really...

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Fufu... Manami is your neighbor. If you're worried, why don't you go see her?
What is she talking about all of a sudden? Ah, she must have misunderstood why I was looking at my cellphone.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Manami and I aren't like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Yes, yes, I know.
Why does this old hag think Manami and I are dating?
I don't know how many times I told her we don't have that kind of relationship.
Sure, I like Manami, but not in that way.
Besides, I have the right to decide that!
"The right to decide", huh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey, just what if though...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: If your daughter went and got married, what would you think?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I mean, married in a way you don't want.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Huh? Why are you asking this so suddenly?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Just roll with it. I'm just curious.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Hmmm... At the least, I...

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Think that Kirino would not do that.
She sure is confident...

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: You think so too, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah...
Exactly as my mother says...
If it was Kirino, this kind of blunder wouldn't happen.
My mother trusts Kirino, so she can say that with complete confidence.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Well, I'm going shopping now.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Watch the house for me, alright?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: One's own daughter...
Speaking of which, what do Saori's parents think of the engagement...
Saori said it was for the "Honor of my parents," but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hmm...
That night...
I tried having the same conversation with my dad who just came home.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey, just what if though...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: If there was this really good person...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: And because she thought it was for her parents' sake, she followed them to the dot.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: To the point that it starts messing with her own life...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: If this was your child, what would you do?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: ...Are we talking about Kirino?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Of course not. This is just a hypothetical question.
Besides, I said someone who was a good person!
Stay within some bounds of doting on your daughter, damn old man!
Which I would never say even if my mouth was torn open, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Hypothetical, huh...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: ...【The Misery of a Child】 is a parent's responsibility.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What do you mean?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: How a kid grows is their own choice.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: But the compass that guides them is their parents.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: A child is the closest thing to your own existence that you raise.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: The closest thing to yourself, huh...
I remembered Saori.
Who is closest to Saori, since she lives alone in an apartment?
Who is supporting her? Who is her compass?
I believed I knew Saori, but...
I hadn't the faintest, slightest idea.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: But, that's why...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Parents who bring their children misfortune are resented for the rest of their lives.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: So it's like that?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Parents who think about things other than their children are useless.
After putting his eyes on his newspaper, he said nothing more.
In my bed, I started remembering what my dad said.
"The Misery of a Child is a parent's responsibility." "Parents who think about things other than their children are useless."
What about Saori's parents?
Do they not think anything of forcing their daughter into a marriage she doesn't want?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Tch.
I casually look at my cellphone, expecting to see some sort of update.
No new mail, no notifications.
There was nothing I could do to solve the problem in my own mind.
